column1: # C4 quests: what each quest counts. The client data has only each quest's text and quota (live keeps the conditions
# server-side), so a quest's Description is matched against these patterns, first match wins (Lobby/QuestConditions.cs).
# Columns: regex on the Description (tags stripped, whitespace collapsed; $q = the quota) <TAB> event <TAB> filter.
# Events (Game/GameTally.cs): GAME_PLAYED (wiki: an early concede doesn't count), GAME_WON, CARD_PLAYED, MINION_SUMMONED,
#   DEATHRATTLE, MANA_SPENT, HERO_POWER, DAMAGE_ENEMY_HERO, LOCATION, CARD_FORGED.
# Filter terms (all must hold; a|b = either): class= (hero class), deck= (a card name in the starting deck), mode=,
#   type=, race= (the client's races: CARDRACE + CardRace tags), school=, tag= (a GAME_TAG the card has), rarity=,
#   cost<=N, cost>=N, cost=N, cost=odd|even (the cost when played), set= (a card set: TAG_CARD_SET name or an @set alias
#   below; membership from CardSetTiming), bonus=N with bonusrace= / bonustag= / bonusany= (race, keyword or rarity:
#   those cards count N times, "(2x - Beast, Dragon, and Undead)"), trait= (what the engine knows that the client data
#   doesn't tag: DRINK). ${name} = the pattern's named group; a list like
#   "Mage, Warlock, or Warrior" or "Dragons and/or Naga" becomes a|b|c.
# @set lines: a set's name in quest texts <TAB> its TAG_CARD_SET name.
# Not counted yet (no match on purpose): other modes (Battlegrounds, Arena, Duels, Tavern Brawl, Spectator), damage by
#   school, golden cards, Taunt minions taking damage.
^Play \$q games with (?<card>.+) in your starting deck\.$
^Play \$q minions that have or give Dark Gift\.$
